study type: mixed-methods study (retrospective evaluation and cross-sectional descriptive study)
outcome: uptake of teleconsultation and teleconference platforms
knowledge and skills of healthcare providers
cohort: healthcare providers in 10 rural health centres, 4 rural district hospitals and 1 regional hospital in Tanzania
finding: The implementation of eHealth tools in rural Tanzania led to increased access to specialist consultation, facilitated knowledge sharing among healthcare providers, and improved reported competencies in clinical practice.
